description:
Every filterable ontology field (vehicle, listing, store, dealer, price, fee, incentive, media, payment) with its
type, range or allowed values, shortcut names, the operators (eq, any_of, contains, range, bool, exists, negate) and
example filters for search_inventory. The full compact list is about 30 KB, so narrow it with prefix or query.

detail.description: compact (default): type, range or up to 12 values. full: up to 40 allowed values, examples and counts; use it with prefix or query.
detail.title: Detail

prefix.description: Only fields starting with this, e.g. canonical, price_summary, incentives, store, dealer_profile, media_block, derived, payment.
prefix.title: Prefix

query.description: Only fields whose name or description contains this text, e.g. fee, color, payment.
query.title: Query

name: list_searchable_fields
